input_contract.vocabulary_discrepancy: The pinned vocabulary contains unk, pad, mask, cls, 4096 six-mers, A/T/C/G/N, eos, and bos for 4105 entries; the paper describes 4104. The released files control execution.
input_contract.phase_contract: Common lane freezes one base-coordinate window. Native zero-shot sensitivity additionally evaluates all six tokenization phases without selecting a phase from outcomes.

representation_and_task_contract.common_lane: Map final hidden states to the six covered bases, mean-pool a fixed 1536-bp region around the variant for REF and ALT, average forward and reverse-complement features after coordinate realignment, and fit the identical linear and two-layer heads to REF, ALT, ALT-minus-REF, and absolute-difference features.
representation_and_task_contract.native_zero_shot_lane: Mask the allele-containing six-mer and compare normalized ALT and REF reconstruction losses across six fixed tokenization phases and both strands; report separately from common embeddings.
representation_and_task_contract.signed_effect_limit: The zero-shot score captures sequence plausibility, not the direction of a cell-type regulatory effect. A supervised head requires nonsealed signed-effect development labels.

runtime_contract.warning: The exact development build recorded in the checkpoint is not a stable package pin. The runtime must either recover its source revision or establish a numerically validated replacement before admission.

source_evidence: The Nature Methods paper and exact Hugging Face revision were queried on 2026-08-22. Only public text, small configuration/vocabulary metadata, and file metadata were read; checkpoint bytes were not downloaded or deserialized.
